method: Same bootstrap resample (with replacement, molecule rows) applied to all protocols each draw; EF@frac recomputed per protocol per draw; reported difference is EF_protocol - EF_P2 on the same draws (paired), with a two-sided percentile-bootstrap p-value. Interval containing 0 means the difference from P2 is not statistically distinguishable at alpha=0.05. Run once on TrueDecoy, once on RandomDecoy.
